title: Upload → Luma reconstruction → splat + collision mesh stored
summary: Wire the upload bundle to the Luma API through the Inngest pipeline: submit the reconstruction job, poll, store the Gaussian splat and collision mesh in staging storage behind signed URLs, track per-job cost, and halt at the daily cap. Blocked until Luma retention terms are on file.

acceptance_tests.test: A capture bundle submitted through the pipeline returns a stored Gaussian splat and a collision mesh in staging, retrievable only through a signed, short-lived URL.
acceptance_tests.evidence: pipeline run log + storage listing (no secrets)

acceptance_tests.test: Per-job cost is recorded; the pipeline halts new jobs at the $50/day cap and resumes the next day.
Luma retention and training terms are on file in legal/vendors/luma.md before any user (non-corpus) scan is sent; corpus scans are Owner-supplied and consented.
No Luma key or storage credential appears in the repo; the key lives only in .env.local / CI.
Ten corpus rooms reconstruct end to end; failure modes are logged with the input that caused them.
